title: consteval as a Compile-Time Gate
prompt: Implement `specVersion` as `consteval`, rejecting anything below version 2 at compile time (throw in the constexpr path), and `pick` as a plain constexpr selector.

tests.name: valid versions pass at compile time
tests.hint: consteval unsigned specVersion(unsigned v) { if (v < 2) throw "too old"; return v; } — throw is allowed in constexpr paths to FAIL compilation.

tests.name: pick selects at compile time too
tests.hint: constexpr unsigned pick(bool useA, unsigned a, unsigned b) { return useA ? a : b; }
